Minecon panel reveals dual wielding and shields coming to Minecraft

Does anybody feel like Minecraft is becoming way too complicated with all these new features? Personally, I feel like the game thrives on simplicity, and that adding too many of these new features may wreck the original feeling of simplicity that the game has brought forth. But, I am open to new things coming to the game and I am still a bit excited about these new changes despite being a bit worried.

I see where you're coming from, with Minecraft's beauty lying in its simplicity and all, but I think dual wielding and swords and shields are a positive addition. If there's one mechanic that is not bettered by simplicity, it's combat. Spam left-clicking and jumping around isn't fun, timing blocks or other strategic moves are, in my opinion at least. I'd love to see them add on to the combat system a bit.

I'm really curious to see where Microsoft takes this though, because there's definitely areas of the game that would be worse if complicated.
